reporting_rules: Every previously selected portable test is retained; already-excluded deployment/fixture tests are omitted from the public export and preserved internally.
Excluded tests are not executed by this command and are never counted as passed.
Parameterized pytest cases determine the actual collected count; 31 files plus 20 nodes is a selection count, not a pass count.
Optional-dependency skips, collection errors, test failures, and unexecuted cases remain distinct in the execution receipt.
This scope is not a complete deployment test suite or an independent numerical convergence study.
The runner does not install packages, contact a scheduler, or alter scientific assertions.
